name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Press from mid-chest with wrists stacked over elbows|Keep shoulder blades pinned to the bench|Lower for two seconds, press without bouncing

name: Incline Bench Press
cues: Set the bench to 30-45 degrees|Touch the bar to the upper chest|Drive the bar up and slightly back

name: Stability Ball Dumbbell Press
cues: Rest head and upper back on the ball, hips level|Squeeze glutes to keep a flat bridge|Press dumbbells up over the chest

name: Chest Dip
cues: Lean the torso slightly forward|Lower until shoulders are just below elbows|Press up without locking out hard

name: Overhead Press
cues: Brace abs and squeeze glutes before each rep|Press in a straight line past the face|Finish with biceps beside the ears

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cues: Soft bend in the elbows|Raise to shoulder height, lead with the elbows|Lower slowly, no swinging

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
cues: Hinge forward with a flat back|Sweep arms wide in an arc|Pause when hands reach shoulder line

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
cues: Hands shoulder-width apart|Keep elbows tucked close to the body|Touch the lower chest, press to lockout

name: EZ Bar Skullcrusher
cues: Upper arms stay vertical|Lower the bar toward the forehead|Extend through the elbows only

name: Weighted Tricep Dip
cues: Keep the torso upright|Lower to a 90-degree elbow angle|Press up and lock out the triceps

name: Standing Barbell Curl
cues: Elbows stay pinned to the sides|Curl without leaning back|Lower all the way to full extension

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
cues: Let the arms hang straight down behind the torso|Curl while keeping elbows still|Squeeze at the top, lower slowly

name: Hammer Preacher Curl
cues: Neutral grip, thumb on top|Armpit snug against the pad|Stop just short of vertical at the top

name: Seated Wrist Curl
cues: Forearms rest on the thighs, palms up|Let the bar roll to the fingertips|Curl the wrists up and squeeze

name: Reverse-Grip EZ Curl
cues: Overhand grip on the angled part of the bar|Keep wrists neutral as you curl|Lower under control

name: Plate Pinch Carry
cues: Pinch two plates smooth side out|Walk tall with short steps|Set down before the grip fails

name: Barbell Shrug
cues: Stand tall, arms straight|Lift shoulders toward the ears|Hold one second, no rolling

name: Dumbbell Shrug
cues: Dumbbells at the sides, neutral grip|Shrug straight up|Lower to a full stretch

name: Barbell Upright Row
cues: Grip just outside shoulder-width|Pull the bar up leading with the elbows|Stop at lower-chest height

name: Seated Cable Row
cues: Sit tall with a slight knee bend|Pull the handle to the lower ribs|Let the shoulder blades reach forward on the return

name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
cues: Chest stays on the pad|Drive elbows back past the torso|Pause and squeeze the shoulder blades

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
cues: Hinge to about 45 degrees, flat back|Row the bar to the belly button|Lower without losing the hinge

name: Lat Pulldown
cues: Grip just outside the shoulders|Pull the bar to the upper chest|Control the bar all the way up

name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
cues: Start from a dead hang|Pull the chest toward the bar|Lower all the way each rep

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
cues: Arms nearly straight, slight hinge|Sweep the bar down to the thighs|Feel the lats, not the triceps

name: Superman
cues: Lie face down, arms extended|Lift arms and legs together|Hold two seconds at the top

name: Sit-Up
cues: Feet anchored, knees bent|Curl up one vertebra at a time|Lower slowly to the floor

name: Lying Leg Raise
cues: Press the lower back into the floor|Raise straight legs to vertical|Lower until just above the floor

name: Weighted Plate Crunch
cues: Hold the plate over the chest|Crunch the ribs toward the hips|Exhale hard at the top

name: Kneeling Cable Lift
cues: Kneel tall, hips square|Lift the rope diagonally across the body|Resist rotation on the way back

name: Kneeling Cable Chop
cues: Start high on one side|Chop down across the body|Keep the hips facing forward

name: Split-Stance Cable Lift
cues: Narrow split stance|Lift from low to high across the body|Stay balanced through the front foot

name: Back Extension
cues: Pad just below the hip crease|Hinge down with a flat back|Rise until the body forms a line

name: Good Morning

name: Barbell Back Squat
cues: Brace before you descend|Knees track over the toes|Drive up through the whole foot

name: Leg Press
cues: Feet shoulder-width, mid platform|Lower until knees reach about 90 degrees|Do not lock the knees at the top

name: Hack Squat
cues: Back flat against the pad|Sink deep with control|Push through the mid-foot

name: Stability Ball Wall Squat

cues: Line the knee up with the machine pivot|Curl the pad under the seat|Return slowly, keep tension

name: Stability Ball Leg Curl
cues: Heels on the ball, hips lifted|Curl the ball toward the glutes|Keep the hips up throughout

cues: Kneel with ankles anchored|Lower the body forward as slowly as possible|Catch with the hands, push back up

cues: Balls of the feet on the edge|Rise as high as possible|Lower into a full stretch

name: Seated Calf Raise
cues: Pad snug above the knees|Press up through the big toe|Pause in the stretch

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
cues: Only the balls of the feet on the platform|Knees straight but not locked|Full range, slow tempo

name: Hip Adduction Machine
cues: Sit upright against the pad|Squeeze the legs together|Open slowly to a comfortable stretch

name: Lateral Lunge with Reach

name: Fire Hydrant Circles

name: IT Band Foam Rolling
